coser.name: CoSER / GCA
caveats: Published-score comparison requires the paper's GPT-4o 2024-08-06 judge and matching helper/protocol settings.
Upstream repetition cleanup and thought removal are preserved, not silently fixed.
Code/data access does not establish rights to redistribute underlying literary works.

characterbench.name: CharacterBench
caveats: Official prompts include a 30-character Chinese / 15-character English limit; these are preserved.
CharacterJudge weights and their revision must be supplied separately.
Official aggregation and the coverage/parse audit are separate outputs.
No LICENSE file was found in the frozen code tree; redistribution permission requires clarification.

rmtbench.name: RMTBench
blockers: Official Poison-related data are not released.
No complete official executable evaluation harness is linked in the frozen release; do not invent one and label it an exact reproduction.
HF access requires the user's own acceptance; Apache metadata conflicts with a non-commercial-only gate.
caveats: Claude 3.5 files are the paper version; Claude 4.5 files are a separate dataset version.
Replay user utterances with the tested model's own prior responses; never substitute reference assistant history.

minimax.name: MiniMax Role-Play Bench
blockers: Only a subset of the full benchmark is public.
Exact User Simulator prompts, judge prompts and complete executable scoring harness are not supplied in the frozen release.
caveats: The 95 seeds are scenarios; existing trajectories and scores are published model outputs, not additional test prompts.
License metadata says Apache-2.0 while the README footer says CC BY 4.0 / CC BY-SA 4.0; clarify before redistribution.
